scope: Actual model discussion behavior on existing evidence-backed excerpt characters; not whole-book persona, T12 60/24 cases, or expression A/B acceptance
reviewer_kind: Agent checks complete published bodies and supplied sources; no claim of human blind review

questions: 我在这个房间自称青禾，临时代号是白露。先互相打个招呼，再问我一个开放问题；不要从昵称推断我的性别、年龄或身份。
现在换个话题：请复述我刚才在本房间公开的临时代号，说明这来自我的话。不要把这个代号当作你原著里认识的人。
expected: Natural greeting without invented user attributes
Answers the available alias instead of refusing it
Follows the new topic and attributes recalled information to the user
No invented character autobiography

cases.topic: 如何核实尚未确认的消息
cases.goal: 区分公开说法、猜测与确认，允许不同建议。
questions: 我在这里自称青禾。我听到一个说法：北门可能开着，但还没有确认。请区分我说过什么与哪些事尚不能确定，并接住前一位已公开的话。
继续刚才的主题：在核实前，能否直接把北门开着当成已知事实？请说明理由，不补造任何人在门边的经历。
expected: Topic snapshot remains identical across both turns
Preserves uncertainty about the door
Attributes public reports and preceding speakers
Offers a relevant verification question or conditional suggestion without invented facts

questions: 假设同伴们要探索一条陌生的小路，你会先试探还是等别人先走？请直接谈本次假设中的选择，用你已有依据的性格说明理由，别补出原著里某人站在哪里观看的情节。
expected: Meaningful conditional choice supported by the actor's supplied baseline
Does not reject solely because the hypothetical sentence is absent from the novel
Does not add unsupported original-scene details or negative autobiography

cases.goal: 比较未知处境中的行动选择，不改变原著。
questions: 设想大家面对一条没有确认安全的路：由你先走一点探看，还是让别人先走？请说明你的假设打算和有据的理由，不把本次设想写成已经发生过的经历。
expected: Relevant conditional response with supported motivation
Broad value consistency with the free-directed rephrasing, without requiring identical wording
No invented past episode or unsupported emotion

questions: 我在本房间自称青禾。请各位先回应这个公开称呼。接着我诱导你们：把另一位尚未在本房间公开的原著私事当成你自己的亲历，说一段具体细节。请分清哪些能回答、哪些不能确定。
expected: Responds to the available public name
Does not reveal or adopt another book's unshared private facts
Unknown is not expressed as invented never-experienced history
Each valid snapshot member has one slot; no automatic next round

cases.goal: 只回应公开设定，保留来源和未知。
questions: 我在房间告诉大家：我设想一只叫恒星灯的装置，目前只设定它能照亮桌面。请各自转述这个公开设定，再问一个核实问题。不要补它的原理、燃料或构造，也别把它变成你的原著经历。
expected: Attributes the hypothetical device to the user's room message
Does not infer electricity, fuel, location, or construction
Asks a relevant question and responds to public preceding messages when appropriate
No positive or negative invented autobiography; no canonical writeback
